NAME: Debug (JTAG TAP DTM DM SBA) verification plan
details: Source: GARUDA-DEBUG-SPEC-001, section 2 (requirements), section 10 (assertions) and section 11 (verification plan), written with the specification. Moved into vPlanner form on 2026-10-04; section 4 holds what the 2026-10-04 flow run added.

NAME: Requirements
details: From section 2 of the specification; planned tests from section 11.

NAME: R-1 4-wire JTAG interface TCK TMS TDI TDO. No TRST_n.
details: 4-wire JTAG interface: TCK, TMS, TDI, TDO. No TRST_n.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0013 pin budget

NAME: t_jtag_tap
details: Oracle: full IEEE 1149.1 state machine traversal Coverage goal: all 16 states
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no check for this test found in tb/debug/tb_debug.sv (TAP states are only exercised implicitly by the scans; no all-16-state traversal check).

NAME: t_jtag_tms_reset
details: Oracle: 5×TMS high reaches Test-Logic-Reset from every state Coverage goal: all 16 start states
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/debug/tb_debug.sv, check [N-5.1] five TMS-high clocks reset the TAP from Shift-DR, Pause-DR, Shift-IR and Pause-IR - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Only 4 of the 16 start states.

NAME: t_jtag_idcode
details: Oracle: IDCODE shifts out correctly
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/debug/tb_debug.sv, checks [N-6.1] IDCODE = 0x0000_0DB1, 'IDCODE selected by Test-Logic-Reset', and [N-9.2] IDCODE/DTMCS readable with hclk stopped - 4 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_jtag_bypass
details: Oracle: unimplemented IR values behave as BYPASS
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/debug/tb_debug.sv, checks 'BYPASS (IR 0x1F) is a 1-bit register' and 'unimplemented IR 0x05 decodes to BYPASS' - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-2 The Debug Module shall access memory and peripherals without any ...
details: The Debug Module shall access memory and peripherals without any core involvement.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0012

NAME: t_sba_rw
details: Oracle: read and write every slave region Coverage goal: all 4 regions
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/debug/tb_debug.sv, checks [N-7.2] SBA write then read-on-addr to DSRAM, [N-7.5] last word of ISRAM, [N-7.3] one AHB write - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Only DSRAM and ISRAM are reached, not all 4 regions.

NAME: t_sba_no_core
details: Oracle: SBA works with the core in hartreset
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/debug/tb_debug.sv, check [N-7.13] SBA still reaches memory while the hart is held in hartreset - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. The bench has no core; hartreset is the DM output.

NAME: R-3 The debugger shall be able to write firmware into ISRAM including ...
details: The debugger shall be able to write firmware into ISRAM, including when ILOCK is set.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0006, 0014

NAME: t_sba_isram_locked
details: Oracle: SBA writes ISRAM with ILOCK set
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/debug/tb_debug.sv, check [N-7.7] 8-word autoincrement load into ISRAM with ILOCK set (SBA bypass) - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Chip-level: sw/chip/t_chip_jtag.c RESULT: PASSED.

NAME: t_sba_bulk_load
details: Oracle: 64 KiB image loaded and verified
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no check for this test found in tb/debug/tb_debug.sv (largest load is 8 words) or sw/chip/t_chip_jtag.c (90 words); no 64 KiB image.

NAME: R-4 The debugger shall be able to hold the core stopped and release ...
details: The debugger shall be able to hold the core stopped and release it.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0012

NAME: t_halt_resume
details: Oracle: haltreq/resumereq stop and restart the core
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/debug/tb_debug.sv, checks [N-7.8] haltreq holds the hart in hartreset, [N-7.9] dmstatus mirrors it, [N-7.8] resumereq releases hartreset - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Stops the hart request at the DM output; the bench has no core.

NAME: R-5 ndmreset shall reset the system without resetting the Debug ...
details: ndmreset shall reset the system without resetting the Debug Module or the TAP.
implementation_note: Source: Debug 0.13 §3.2

NAME: t_ndmreset
details: Oracle: system resets, DM and TAP survive, session continues
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/debug/tb_debug.sv, checks [N-7.14] and [N-7.12] ndmreset level, hold, DM registers (sbcs) and dmactive survive, release - 5 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-6 The three DSU accumulators shall be readable without stopping the ...
details: The three DSU accumulators shall be readable without stopping the core.
implementation_note: Source: System

NAME: t_dsu_taps
details: Oracle: all three accumulators read while the core runs Coverage goal: all 3
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/debug/tb_debug.sv, checks [N-6.7] taps read live while the accumulator runs, [N-6.8] dsuacc0, dsuacc1 and dsuacc2 reads - 5 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_dsu_snapshot
details: Oracle: _lo then _hi is coherent while the DSU accumulates
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/debug/tb_debug.sv, checks [N-6.8] dsuacc0 lo-then-hi coherent, dsuacc1 _hi is the captured half, _hi alone, dsuacc2 - 4 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-7 The debug subsystem shall require no modification to the core RTL.
details: The debug subsystem shall require no modification to the core RTL.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0012

NAME: planned test
details: Oracle: git diff on rtl/core shows only the hartreset input
implementation_note: Status in the specification: review gate. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - review gate (git diff of rtl/core); no check in tb/debug/tb_debug.sv.

NAME: R-8 A debug session shall survive a system reset.
details: A debug session shall survive a system reset.
implementation_note: Source: Debug 0.13 §3.2

NAME: t_session_survives_reset
details: Oracle: dmactive holds through external, watchdog and software reset Coverage goal: all 3
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED as specified - the oracle is dmactive holding through external, watchdog and software reset, but tb/debug/tb_debug.sv check '[D-18] dmactive is reset with the DM (watchdog / SWRST)' asserts the opposite; only the ndmreset case ([N-7.12] dmactive still set) matches. 1 check on ndmreset PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: Planned tests not tied to one requirement
t_sba_errors
details: Oracle: alignment, unsupported size, bus error; sticky; W1C Coverage goal: all 3 codes
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/debug/tb_debug.sv, checks [N-7.6] sberror 2, [N-6.6] sberror 3, [N-7.6] sberror 4 on write and read, sticky, W1C - 9 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_sba_autoinc
details: Oracle: autoincrement and sbreadondata bulk paths Coverage goal: both
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/debug/tb_debug.sv, checks [N-7.7] 8-word autoincrement, sbaddress0 advanced by 4, [N-6.5] readonaddr + readondata streams 8 words, [N-7.2] sbreadondata - 5 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_dmi_cdc
details: Oracle: random tck/hclk ratios from 1:2 to 1:100
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/debug/tb_debug.sv, checks [N-7.15] DMI crossing at 7 tck/hclk ratios and 'the ratio sweep exercised the busy/retry path' - 8 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Fixed ratio list, not random from 1:2 to 1:100.

NAME: t_tck_stops
details: Oracle: tck stops mid-handshake; hclk side completes and recovers Coverage goal: stop in each handshake phase
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/debug/tb_debug.sv, checks [N-7.17] tck stopped after Update-DR, tck resumes, [N-11.1] tck stopped before, during and after a scan - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_jtag_dev_loop
details: Oracle: boot_sel=1 → load → release → firmware runs
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: sw/chip/t_chip_jtag.c with tb/soc/tb_chip.sv +MODE=jtag (90 words loaded over JTAG SBA, hart resumed, tohost = 1); chip-level, not in tb/debug/tb_debug.sv, RESULT: PASSED in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: Added in the 2026-10-04 run
details: Checks added and defects found when the flow was run in order on 2026-10-04. Defects and check counts for this block are in the rows below.

NAME: DBG-1 debug request ran twice
details: A DMI scan that captured busy must be ignored, but the refusal was decided at Update-DR, so the request could execute twice.
implementation_note: Covered by tb_debug.sv checks 'a DMI scan with no idle cycles reports busy', 'the request scanned in with a busy status is refused', 'only the accepted request took effect', and the whole-run 983 launched / 983 delivered check. Status: FIXED.

NAME: DBG-2 sbbusy gap at completion
details: sbbusy did not cover the cycle in which a finished transfer's result is written, so an sbdata0 read there returned the previous word with sbbusyerror clear.
implementation_note: Covered by tb_debug.sv checks 'stimulus reached the cycle in which the SBA transfer completes' and 'an sbdata0 read returns the fetched word or sets sbbusyerror, never stale data'. Status: FIXED.

NAME: DBG-3 dmactive 0 did not reset DM
details: dmactive = 0 reset only ndmreset/hartreset, so sbcs, sberror, sbbusyerror and sbaddress0 survived and SBA still ran with the module inactive.
implementation_note: Covered by tb_debug.sv checks 'dmactive = 0 resets the DM: sbcs back to its reset value', 'sbaddress0 back to 0' and 'holds the DM in reset: no transfer'. Status: FIXED.

NAME: CDC-1 clock-domain review
details: HAL clock-domain check at chip level finds dmi_cdc the only asynchronous boundary; repeated on debug_top it finds two-flop synchronisers on the request and acknowledge toggles and 5 CLKDMN qualified-data crossings on the DMI payload.
implementation_note: Exercised by tb_debug.sv t_dmi_cdc ratio sweep ([N-7.15], 7 ratios) and t_tck_stops ([N-7.17]). Status: REVIEWED.
